newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money and bond markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money and bond markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Taiwan's money and bond markets will be closed today and on Saturday due to a national holiday. They will reopen on Monday.
On Thursday, the overnight interbank rate ended at 5.069 percent against Wednesday's 4.906 close, with 30-day commercial paper up to 4.85-5.00 percent against 4.80-4.85.
The government bond yields on Thursday closed higher amid bearish sentiment, with the seven-year 83/2 government bond yield at 5.465 and seven-year 85/3 bond yield at 5.68.
